note: Recast from the original description of Emerson 1925 (in English), where the species was placed in the subgenus Kalotermes (Rugitermes); the description is based on 1 male (the holotype, a king) and several soldiers from 3 nests, the type locality being Kartabo, British Guiana. The hind tibia length of the soldier is damaged in the scanned text and is not listed.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head width 1.38—1.48 mm and head length 3.21—3.53 mm, pronotum width 1.51—1.67 mm, proportionally distinctly wider than the head and also longer than in K. flavicinctus; femora proportionally stout. It differs from K. bicolor in that all the legs are uniform in colour. The original considered this species close to the description of K. rugosus, but the soldiers assigned to that species by Silvestri (1903) differ far too greatly in body size, so the species is provisionally kept separate; K. occidentalis is larger.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Male: head black. Antenna pale yellow, segment 2 about as long as segment 3, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 4. Eyes rather small, 0.26 mm from the lower margin of the head; ocelli small, 0.064 mm from the eye. Labrum yellow, clypeus white. Thoracic pleura brown. Pronotum yellow, anterior margin concave, the sides rounded, narrowing slightly posteriorly, the posterior margin slightly concave. Legs yellowish brown, uniform in colour throughout; arolium evident. Wing scales dark brown, contrasting strongly with the yellow pronotum and abdomen. Abdominal tergites yellow, the sternites brownish yellow, slightly darker than the tergites. Measurements: head length 1.48 mm; head width 1.25 mm; eye diameter 0.32 mm; pronotum width 1.35 mm; hind tibia length 1.00 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Antenna 13—14 segments. It differs from K. flavicinctus in body size, in the distinctly stouter femora and in the pronotum being wider and longer relative to the head. Measurements: head length 3.21—3.53 mm; head width 1.38—1.48 mm; pronotum length 0.71—0.83 mm; pronotum width 1.51—1.67 mm; left mandible length 1.42 mm.
